text.p: Leg cramps forced Goran Ivanisevic to retire from his European/African zone group one Davis Cup singles on Friday, giving Austria a 1-0 lead over Croatia.
Ivanisevic retired in the fifth set after three and a half hours of play to hand Austria's Gilbert Schaller a 6-3 6-4 6-7 (3-7) 2-6 3-1 win.
Ivanisevic later told reporters he was uncertain about his participation in Saturday's doubles.
"I don't know if I will play. My left thigh still hurts although it's not cramping anymore. It is the first time in my life that this has happened to me.
"I began feeling pains in the fourth set. In the fifth set I was starting to get the match under control again but I had to run a lot and the pains got worse.
"Then at 3-1 it got so bad I simply had to give up," said Ivanisevic.
Austria's world number two Thomas Muster was playing Croatia's Sasha Hirszon in Friday's second singles.
